programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: S3E5 - Durrellovi

programme.desc: Po čustvenem srečanju z Rachel se Franklin vrne v hišo družine Verinder v Yorkshiru, da bi poiskal odgovore. Tam spozna dr. Ezro Jenningsa, ki mu ponudi pomoč.

programme.title: S1E1 - Razsodnost in rahločutnost
programme.desc: Henry Dashwood umre in vso svojo lastnino zapusti prvorojencu Johnu, kar pomeni, da njegova druga žena in tri hčerke ostanejo z majhnim prihodkom. Pomoč jim ponudi sir John Middleton, sorodnik gdč. Dashwood, ki jih sprejme v hišico na svoji posesti. Vsi vedo, da bi se družina rešila, če bi se ena od deklet bogato poročila, čeprav bi bilo najbolje, če bi si vse našle soproge...

programme.title: S11E1 - Smrt v raju: Ugrabitev
programme.desc: Ko se na pogled običajna ugrabitev konča z umorom, morajo Neville in ekipa raziskati, kaj je šlo narobe in kako je oseba umrla.

programme.title: S3E3 - Ulica upanja
programme.desc: Nicole ni ravno navdušena, ko v Port Devine prispe Clintov premeteni brat Sly. Marlene medtem sprejme veliko življenjsko odločitev.

programme.title: S3E4 - Ulica upanja
programme.desc: Shay preživi bližnje srečanje z nepremišljenim motoristom, kar vodi do preiskave, ki vključuje vrečo konoplje, boksarskega prvaka in severni sij.

programme.title: S6E7 - Župnik Brown: Ples smrti
programme.desc: Oče Brown preiskuje nenadno in sumljivo smrt plesalke.

programme.title: S2E8 - Paradiž
programme.desc: Zolajev roman Au Bonheur des Dames, po katerem je posneta nadaljevanka, je najprej v nadaljevanjih izhajal v pariškem literarnem časopisu Gil Blas, kot roman pa izšel leta 1883. Avtorji nadaljevanke so dogajanje v sedemdesetih letih 19. stoletja prenesli v mesto na severovzhod Anglije. Glavna junakinja, mlada Denise Lovett pride iz podeželja v mesto, kjer živi njen stric Edmund, trgovec z metrskim blagom in krojač, ki je tik pred propadom, saj so nasproti njegove trgovinice odprli prvo veleblagovnico, imenovano PARADIŽ, ki je takoj privabila in prevzela kupce okoliških trgovin. Na stričevo razočaranje se Denise zaposli kot prodajalka v veleblagovnici. Vodja prodajalk je zahtevna gospa Audrey, lastnik, ki takoj opazi Denise, pa je mladi in ovdoveli John Moray, s katerim se želi poročiti Katherine, razvajena hči lorda Glendenninga. Gre za zgodbo o ljubezni, o ambicijah, o napredku in se vrti okrog življenj ljudi v mestu ter vsakdanjega utripa v veleblagovnici. Glavne junake, vsakega na svoj način, omejuje svet, v katerem živijo in preteklost, ki jim sledi …

programme.title: S7E6 - Lewis

programme.title: Life on the Bay
programme.desc: Life on the bay continues for the hundreds who have made this Fife caravan park their second home and for the staff who make sure everything runs smoothly. In this episode, a new caravan is installed on the site with the help of a huge crane, but the steep hillside and gusting winds prove a challenge. Meanwhile, a long-standing member of staff prepares to say farewell, but not before he has tried out the biggest rides at the Burntisland Fair. And the bay’s newest recruit is welcomed to the business.

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: For many farmers, summer means one thing - show season - and the Royal Highland Show is the highlight in the calendar. The Barclays boys are showing pedigree Beltex and their finest Suffolks before going head-to-head in the Young Handlers competition. It’s also a major event for budding young farmers Rachel and Camy, who, for the first time, are showing only animals raised on their own farm. Hopes are pinned on their Cheviot lamb Patch to prove she’s every bit as good as Camy predicted. And in Moray, Nikki and Ollie are preparing a show of their own. They’re opening up their farm gates to give the public a taste of what they’re all about.

programme.title: Murder Case
programme.desc: A team of detectives arrive in the market town of Elgin tasked with investigating the brutal murder of a 32-year-old mother of two. On 16 November 2023, Lucretia ‘Kiesha’ Donaghy’s body is discovered in her home after worried friends are unable to reach her. She has been victim of a frenzied attack. We follow the detectives' every move as they search for key evidence and piece together information to uncover the truth of who killed Kiesha. The case quickly unfolds into a complex investigation which demands relentless focus and all of the team’s expertise. Kiesha’s aunt Rachel and her best friend Bob share memories of her vibrant personality, the struggles she faced, and the heartbreak of losing her. With intimate access to the detectives and Kiesha’s loved ones, this episode reveals the personal impact of her murder and the dedicated work involved in seeking justice.

programme.title: Paramedics on Scene
programme.desc: The Special Operations Response Team is called to a fall on Arthur’s Seat, where a tourist has been injured near the summit. Paramedics must navigate cragged rocks and scores of hillwalkers to reach their patient, with the help of their most versatile, all-terrain vehicle: the Wolverine. In Aberdeen, student paramedic Amy faces a final assessment on her last training shift. Along with her two senior colleagues, she has to help a drunk man who has fallen over in chaotic circumstances and is making inappropriate comments. They also treat Colin, who is suffering from a serious allergic reaction and in considerable distress. Members of the Special Operations Response team are called to another job, this one just outside Edinburgh, where a man has been injured in an apparent street fight. The team must help coordinate the ambulance response while the police try to control a volatile scene.

ఒక ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు, భక్తులు భగవంతుని బోధనలను స్తుతించడానికి పాటలు పాడతారు, ఆధ్యాత్మికత మార్గాన్ని తీసుకోమని కోరతారు.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Love to Death
programme.desc: Love and money are a beautiful marriage, for the lucky ones they create a life of happiness and ease. Unless the love is of money, the bride is a killer, and the groom their victim.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women are more often prey than predators, but the exceptions are deadly women indeed. In this episode, we’ll discover what drove these deadly women to prey on the unsuspecting.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Love Gone Wrong
programme.desc: Love can be beautiful, love can be blind and love can be deadly. Desire and jealousy are powerful forces driving women to dark and horrifying places in their minds.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Hearts of Stone
programme.desc: Deadly Women are not always the ones you expect. They are not the strangers lurking in the dark, they are a young mother, a supportive wife and a grandmother - all killers. Behind their loving masquerade lies a wake of family horror and pain.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women burn madly with jealousy, an anger so deep they’ll kill to satisfy it. What makes them turn from “green with envy” to “lethal with jealousy?" Find out as we explore their hearts of darkness.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Behind their friendly smiles, deadly women hide histories of bloodshed and murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women never get their hands dirty: no blood touched them because they manipulate others to kill for them...but they didn't get away.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Married to Murder
programme.desc: To the outside world, their marriages seemed happy. But behind closed doors, there was no domestic bliss. These women wanted out, but getting a divorce wasn’t their preferred option.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: In some cases, the transformation from everyday woman to brutal killer is activated by a man. A boyfriend or husband can become the focus of a deadly obsession.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Crimes of revenge are usually single acts of passion. A brew of hatred and restitution boils over in a manic moment of fury. Once caught, revenge killers usually display remorse and atonement.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A lovely lady with an innocent smile, kind eyes, a charming personality? No one would suspect a woman like that would murder. These women don’t look or behave like killers.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed. From husbands to strangers to other people’s babies, they spilt blood for money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While their sisters chose a life of sensible, suburban motherhood, these deadly women chose a life of crime. They lived with the thrills, the danger and the deadly consequences of being outlaws.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Obsession
programme.desc: Deciphering what causes minds to corkscrew out of control is the complex work of the criminal profiler. Obsessions can take many forms: beauty, devotion, ego and power.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Under His Control
programme.desc: These are love stories with bleak, bloody endings. Blinded by desire, obsessed and malleable, some women fall into lethal relationships with dangerous, controlling men.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Teen Killers
programme.desc: They were too young to drink or vote but they were not too young to commit the most brutal of crimes. Some were driven by pure curiosity: how would it feel to take a life?

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live (Habiter le monde), Prancūzija, 2017
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it. In this series of 20 films, of 26 minutes each, the habitat will be a major showcase revealing our capacity to adapt ourselves at a time where we need to find solutions in order to address immense changes.

programme.title: Qatar Cross Country Rally - 2020
programme.desc: Manateq Qatar Cross-Country Rally signaled the opening round of the FIA World Cup for Cross-Country Rallies at the stunning, awe-inspiring state of Qatar. Organised by the Qatar Motor and Motorcycle Federation (QMMF), the event has attracted 33 teams and competitors from 17 nations. Five days of intense competition and 1,444.99 kilometres in the challenging Qatar desert, will test cars and drivers to their limits. Although the event has attracted many teams and competitors, the 3-time Dakar winner Nasser Saleh Al-Attiyah stands out prominently. Al-Attiyah has proven to be a force to be reckoned within the cross-country rally scene. Only just missing the mark in the last Dakar Rally, the born and bred Qatari will be keen to compete and impress on home soil.

programme.title: S1E2 - Fotografija številka 6: Severna Britanija
programme.desc: Fotografija številka 6 je popolnoma nova oddaja, v kateri nas igralec Alan Fletcher popelje po svetu. Skozi fotografski objektiv si bomo ogledali veliko več, kot nam lahko ponudijo vodiči. Iskali bomo priložnost za čudovito in izmuzljivo fotografijo, v kateri bomo ujeli čustva, zemljepis in povezave med ljudmi, s katerimi se Alan srečuje.

programme.desc: Od najboljše ulične hrane do najbolj norih živilskih tržnic.

programme.title: S17E12 - Divja duša
programme.desc: Divja duša vam prinaša najnovejše v ekstremnih športih; vključno z ekskluzivnimi intervjuji, edinstvenim in strokovnim poročanjem o dogodkih ter pogledom na prihodnje akcijske zvezde. Divja duša je športni program in magazin za alt-kulturo.

programme.title: S17E13 - Divja duša
programme.desc: Divja duša vam prinaša najnovejše v ekstremnih športih; vključno z ekskluzivnimi intervjuji, edinstvenim in strokovnim poročanjem o dogodkih ter pogledom na prihodnje akcijske zvezde. Divja duša je športni program in magazin za alt-kulturo.

programme.title: S1E4 - Vojne dronov: Duh
programme.desc: Ta serija sooči sedem dvočlanskih ekip med seboj v prizadevanju, da zasnujejo in zgradijo vrhunski dron ter v tekmovanju premagajo zahtevne ovire. Ekipe prihajajo z vsega sveta, njihova začetna naloga pa je izdelati najsodobnejše leteče plovilo, preden ga popeljejo skozi velikanski labirint. V naslednjih epizodah se ekipe med seboj pomerijo v dirkah, med letom pobirajo predmete in se prikrito izogibajo pajkovi mreži senzorjev gibanja, med številnimi drugimi nalogami.

programme.title: S1E5 - Vojne dronov: Iskanje in reševanje
programme.desc: Ta serija sooči sedem dvočlanskih ekip med seboj v prizadevanju, da zasnujejo in zgradijo vrhunski dron ter v tekmovanju premagajo zahtevne ovire. Ekipe prihajajo z vsega sveta, njihova začetna naloga pa je izdelati najsodobnejše leteče plovilo, preden ga popeljejo skozi velikanski labirint. V naslednjih epizodah se ekipe med seboj pomerijo v dirkah, med letom pobirajo predmete in se prikrito izogibajo pajkovi mreži senzorjev gibanja, med številnimi drugimi nalogami.

programme.title: S1E4 - Globlje: Pattaya in Phai
programme.desc: Še naprej raziskujemo Tajsko in se odpravimo v Pattayo. Za tem obiščemo mesto na severu, Pai, ki je popolno za prvo vožnjo z mopedom. Sprehodili se bomo skozi ogromen park in se spoznali z bogato zgodovino tropskega vrta Nong Nuch. Obiskali bomo tudi najverjetneje edini atelje motociklov po meri na Tajskem in preživeli razburljiv dan v družbi slonov. Zvečer bomo na Tajskih tržnicah poskusili durian in se spoznali s krajevnimi hipiji.

programme.title: S1E4 - Pot na jug: Gran Sabana in Kluane Lake
programme.desc: Pot na jug je pustolovski okoljski dokumentarni film. Ko se podnebje spreminja, se razglaša okoljska kriza. Štirje pustolovci iz Švedske, Španije in Velike Britanije sprejemajo izzive vse življenje. Tokrat s kolesi prevozijo razdaljo 16.765 milj in obiščejo 17 držav.

programme.title: S1E5 - Pot na jug: V divjino
programme.desc: Pot na jug je pustolovski okoljski dokumentarni film. Ko se podnebje spreminja, se razglaša okoljska kriza. Štirje pustolovci iz Švedske, Španije in Velike Britanije sprejemajo izzive vse življenje. Tokrat s kolesi prevozijo razdaljo 16.765 milj in obiščejo 17 držav.

programme.title: S1E3 - Foodie izkušnje: Indija
programme.desc: Liesel si ogleduje mesto, znano po svoji gastronomiji, Kalkuti. Od preizkušanja ulične hrane do manj znanih draguljev, vključno z delikatesami v kitajski četrti. Zgodba o ogledih, prepletenih s hrano, miniaturnih lokalih, ki strežejo cmoke, neurejenih ribjih tržnicah in seveda, o ponosu Bengala, ribi hilsa. Se Kalkuta lahko primerja z ostalimi metropolitanskimi mesti v Indiji? Izvedeli bomo v današnji epizodi.

programme.title: S1E4 - Foodie izkušnje: Nevada
programme.desc: Ta raziskovalna misija se začne v atmosferi mesta greha na Vegas Stripu. Po nenasitni izkušnji z generičnim bifejem, se Liesel odloči odpraviti na iskanje ikoničnih krajev v Nevadi. Od mest duhov preko pošastnih izzivov s hrano, do barov "lukenj" sredi ničesar, na tem izletu bo doživela vse. V severni Nevadi bo doživela ponoven vzpon baskijske kuhinje in odkrila, da se tudi v Renu lahko fino je. Na izletu do mesta Virginia city bo ugotovila, da se v Nevadi najdejo tudi obsedeni bari, kjer naj bi obiskovalci iz 1800-tih še zmeraj strašili krajane.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: In the main event, featherweight champ Petch (168-39-3, 27 KO) looks to defend his crown for the sixth time when he welcomes the challenge of local hero Ahmad Chikh Mousa (58-8-1, 28 KO). The co-main event will see a crucial fight between Romania’s Benjamin Adegbuyi (35-8, 20 KO) and Sofian Laïdouni (35-2-1, 17 KO) of France that will decide who will qualify for the GLORY Heavyweight Grand Prix in December.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The interim-GLORY Heavyweight Title will be up for grabs as top ranked heavyweight contender Antonio Plazibat (22-4, 16 KO) collides with the number two ranked Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (24-2-1, 12 KO) in the main event. These teammates will have to put their friendship aside for one night and go head-to-head for GLORY gold. Also on the card are title fights in the Middleweight, Welterweight and Light Heavyweight divisions.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: A huge title fight rematch will take place in the main event as rivals Tiffany ‘Time Bomb’ van Soest (24-6-2, 9 KO) and Sarah Moussaddak (8-3, 1 KO) lock horns once again. The rest of the card is stacked with some exciting names and thrilling fights. French Algerian Nordine Mahieddine (27-15, 12 KO) collides with France’s Abderahmane Coulibaly (58-20-1, 25 KO) in a big heavyweight contest, Germany’s Denis Wosik (37-8-1, 9 KO) meets the super popular Albanian Berjan Peposhi (27-3, 16 KO), former GLORY title challenger Karim Ghajji (103-17-1, 53 KO) returns and squares-off against Serbia’s Nikola Todorovic (26-3, 14 KO), and Iliass Hammouche (32-6, 7 KO) will finally make his much anticipated debut against Germany’s Florian Kroger (19-9, 6 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Badr Hari will go head-to-head with Estonia’s Uku Jürjendal in a GLORY Grand Prix Qualifier. Middleweight Champ Petchpanomrung will defend his belt against newcomer David Meija. Bulgarias own, Stoyan Koprivlenski, will face off with Romanian Sorin Caliniuc. Also fighting is Heavyweight Levi Rigters and Luis Tavares makes his return.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The undisputed heavyweight king of kickboxing will be decided in the main event as long reigning champion Rico Verhoeven (60-10, 20 KO) goes up against arguably his most dangerous opponent to date in interim-heavyweight champ Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (25-2-1, 13 KO). Middleweight champ Donovan Wisse (19-1, 10 KO) puts his title on the line against number one contender Michael Boapeah (16-3-1, 7 KO). Wisse has looked unstoppable so far during his title run but now he faces an in-form Michael Boapeah who holds a win over the only man to beat Wisse. The welterweight division sees top ranked stars go head-to-head as Hamicha (40-2, 30 KO) takes on Diaguely Camara (24-4-1, 10 KO) and Jay Overmeer (29-5, 15 KO) meets Chico Kwasi (41-5, 22 KO). It’s also an important evening at middleweight with Serkan Ozcaglayan (45-8, 36 KO) colliding with Ulric Bokeme (31-4, 17 KO) and the recently debuted Iliass Hammouche (33-6, 7 KO) facing Ivan Galaz (58-10-1, 15 KO). A huge featherweight match-up between the number one ranked Abraham Vidales (15-2, 12 KO) and number two ranked Ahmad Chikh Mousa (58-8-1, 28 KO) plus an exciting light heavyweight bout between Ibrahim El Bouni (41-8-1, 22 KO) and Stefan Latescu (16-2, 7 KO) will round out the main card.

programme.title: Rivalry in Music
programme.desc: S01E02 Two men without whom the profession of conductor would not be what it is today. Two men who couldn't be more different from each other: Arturo Toscanini and Wilhelm Furtwängler. The former was rigorously faithful to the musical score, the latter conducted with radical subjectivity. In 1931 they both conducted at the Bayreuth Festival - for the first and last time. Soon the polite rivalry turned into bitter enmity. Both men were forced to take a stand on the regimes in their respective countries - and chose radically different paths. Toscanini, "the dictator", bravely challenged Mussolini; Furtwängler, a conservative, meanwhile proclaimed that art is always apolitical and reluctantly made a pact with the Nazis. The documentary not only opens up the different musical universes of the two great conductors by retracing their careers in Milan, Bayreuth and New York, but also raises a question that is more topical than ever: what has art to do with politics? Directed by Thomas...

programme.title: Wagner's Jews
programme.desc: This documentary explores the deeply complex relationship between Richard Wagner, his anti-Semitic ideology, and the Jewish musicians who supported and collaborated with him throughout his career. Through archival sources, interviews, historical re-enactments, and musical performances, the film examines questions that continue to resonate today: can artistic achievement be separated from personal prejudice, and how does history shape the way art is understood?

programme.title: Betroffenheit by Crystal Pite
programme.desc: A haunting and deeply expressive dance-theatre experience exploring trauma, memory, isolation, and the fragile boundary between reality and illusion. Movement, text, sound, and theatrical imagery create a tense psychological landscape where past and present collide. Moments of vulnerability are contrasted with disturbing intensity, revealing the struggle to confront painful memories and the complex ways the mind attempts to survive, escape, and heal.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village of Dunstan, leads Barnaby and Jones to investigate the deaths of reclusive couple, Ron and Libby Wilson. Not too far away a fiery dispute is in full swing, between a builder who has a very short fuse and a group of road protesters, protesting about plans for a bypass. With hostilities almost at breaking point, it is not long before another death rocks the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the body of Charlie Finleyson is found in woodland in Midsomer Sonning. Barnaby and Jones begin to scrutinise the employees at the offices of Midsomer Life magazine. It is discovered that Mr Finleyson was married to the ex-wife of Guy Sandys, the wealthy owner of the magazine. The detectives also become aware of a dispute between Guy and the owner of the Morecroft Hotel. With tensions starting to rise between the locals and visitors from London.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a children's magic show, a performer assisting with a trick, is poisoned whilst on stage. It is found that the poison came from a species of Ecuadorean frog. Barnaby and Jones discover that conflict is once again brewing between a village occult guide and enthusiast Ernest Baillol and famous writer Aloysius Wilmington who are both searching for a treasured antique book on the subject.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A team building exercise is imminent planned by a new acting Chief Superintendent John Cotton and Barnaby and Jones are very reluctant to take part. Following an explosion in a truck at a haulage yard, both the detectives see the opportunity as a distraction to investigate. It is not long after that a body is discovered, when a trunk resurfaces from the nearby lake. It is identified as Alec Grainger, a man who had been arguing with James Parkes, the son of Colonel Matt Parkes.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Monks Barton, two couples seemingly disappear from their cottages. When Barnaby and Jones arrive and learn of the legendary, mysterious haunted woods, they remain sceptical. Shortly after a body is found in a shallow grave, answering to the description of one of the 'missing'. The detectives have to delve much deeper into the woods and beyond to find out if ghosts are really to blame or something else.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Milton Cross depend on lord of the manor Edward Milton, for their jobs and income. When Sonia Woodley is found murdered in the churchyard, two years after the death of her abusive husband Gerald, the murder weapon is discovered to be tailor's shears, but which one of villagers is responsible? Barnaby and Jones arrive at Woodley and Woodley, the tailors to find out, to discover that the vicar had received a letter from Sonia a few days before.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a council meeting, Mayor Dave Hicks announces plans to awaken an annual trip to Brighton. Barnaby suspects his proposal to buy coastal land there is a fraud. Barnaby reluctantly joins the party, but during their time in Brighton, hated property developer Hugh Dalgleish is beheaded on a ghost train ride. The detectives together with Tom's cousin DCI John Barnaby gather who from the party or someone else could have been responsible before other murders occur and secrets are uncovered.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Ford Florey is anything but quiet, when the Wild West Society bring their show and fair, consisting of many stalls and a shooting re-enactment. The witch on the 'Dunk the Witch' stall, gets truly dunked and goes horribly wrong, when the water starts turning red. Barnaby and Jones have to be alert with a shooter in their midst. With many grudges, jealousies and a dispute over wasteland, known as 'the swamp', as possible motives, it is not long before more people turn up dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: On a dark night in the village of March Magna, Joyce Barnaby swerves her car and narrowly misses a shadowy figure in the road. Shortly after a body is found in the local old cemetery. The victim Gerald Ebbs was a member of the council and of the village's library. It is discovered from the villagers that Gerald had had a strange fixation on both the old hospital and cemetery; in particular a grave from within.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Devington Manor Winter School led by internationally renowned musician Sir Michael Fielding, is a magnet for many aspiring piano students. Amongst the latest batch of students is Zoe Stock, a gifted young lady. Whilst in the grounds of the manor and by the riverbank, Zoe sees a woman jump from the bridge and disappear underwater. When Barnaby and Jones start their enquiries into the possible drowning, they discover many shady connections to the past.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When boxer John Kinsella wins a world title in New York, the village of Midsomer Morchard are overjoyed at his success. Shortly afterwards a solicitor is found dead by his assistant and Kinsella's manager. Barnaby and Jones start to investigate and come across infidelity, anger, betrayals and blackmail. When a Victorian prize-fight re-enactment turns nasty and Kinsella's manager is found murdered in his home's gym.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The Midsomer Conservation Society are up in arms, when a recent new build, called Swanscombe House is a highlight of an open garden day. It leads to an ugly confrontation between a couple of its members and those responsible for the planning application, design and build. The people of which are suspected of involvement in a money-making scam. Political squabbles, burglaries and sexual liaisons all come to the fore in picturesque Great Pelfe.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A spa weekend at Swavely Manor, proves far from relaxing, when Tom and Joyce Barnaby arrive. It starts stressful and goes rather downhill when a female client is found dead in the flotation chamber, by Joyce. Barnaby takes a break from his treatment to investigate alongside Jones. The mystery deepens when the woman's husband disappears in the night shortly afterwards. Tom's worries about his future seem to distract him from the case.

From building a pond for frogs to building themselves into a box, it's always chaotic!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey

వ్యాఖ్యాత ఈనాటి సామాజిక, ఆర్థిక, రాజకీయ సమస్యల గురించి సమాచారాన్ని, ప్రస్తుత సంఘటనలకు సంబంధించిన విశేషాలను అందిస్తారు.
प्रस्तुतकर्ते दिवसभराच्या सामाजिक, अर्थविषयक आणि राजकीय विषयांवर आधारित ताज्या घडामोडी आणि माहिती सादर करतात.

programme.title: South Park: Clubhouses
programme.desc: Clubhouses: Stan and Kyle build a clubhouse, so they can play truth or dare with Wendy and Bebe. Cartman and Kenny decide to build their own rival clubhouse based on The Ewoks Village. (S2, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Cow Days
programme.desc: Cow Days: The boys try to win Terrance and Phillip dolls at the carnival but a dodgy carnie keeps changing the rules - time to call "shenanigans"! Cartman dates Leonardo DiCaprio. (S2, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Chef Aid
programme.desc: Chef Aid: Chef realises that Alanis Morissette's (fictional) hit song "Stinky Britches" is a song that he wrote years ago but the record company aren't interested in giving him any credit. (S2, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Spooky Fish
programme.desc: Spooky Fish: When Stan is given a fish by his Aunt, he has a feeling there's something not quite right about it. Sure enough it's not long before there's evil goings on. (In spooky vision!) (S2, E15)

programme.title: South Park: Merry Christmas Charlie Manson
programme.desc: Merry Christmas, Charlie Manson!: Cartman's Uncle Howard escapes from prison with another inmate, Charlie Manson. The boys want to go see Mr Hankey at the mall but no one will take them. (S2, E16)

programme.title: South Park: Gnomes
programme.desc: Gnomes (a.k.a. Underpants Gnomes): The boys must write an essay for school. Tweek suggests they write about gnomes that visit him every night and steal his pants. What will they discover? (S2, E17)

programme.title: South Park: Rainforest Shmainforest
programme.desc: Rainforest Schmainforest: The boys go to the Costa Rican rainforest as a part of the "Getting Gay With Kids" choir tour, but Cartman is on a mission to cause havoc. Jennifer Aniston guests. (S3, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Spontaneous Combustion
programme.desc: Spontaneous Combustion: The citizens of South Park are randomly exploding and it's up to Stan to find the cause. Kyle discovers his dad is having problems with erectile dysfunction. (S3, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Succubus
programme.desc: The Succubus (a.k.a. Chef's Mama): The boys discover that Chef has a new girl who has changed him from a free-spirited, soul-singing hipster to that of a mediocre, religious paper pusher. (S3, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Tweek Vs. Craig
programme.desc: Tweek vs. Craig: The boys coerce two of their classmates, Tweek and Craig, into a schoolyard fight. Craig learns martial arts with the aid of Cartman. Tweek is taught to box by Uncle Jimbo. (S3, E05)

programme.title: South Park: Jakovasaurs
programme.desc: Jakovasaurs: While camping, the boys discover the last two Jakovasaurs (a parody of Jar Jar Binks) on the planet. Will the townsfolk welcome them with open arms or find them very annoying? (S3, E04)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter than Summer: The Sexual Harassment Panda
programme.sub-title: Hotter than Summer: The Sexual Harassment Panda
programme.desc: The Sexual Harassment Panda: After a school educational talk from Petey the Panda, Cartman decides to sue Stan for sexual harassment. Suing fever starts to grip the entire town! (S3, E06)

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E02 - Nature's World Wide Web
programme.desc: When animals share info to help each other decide, it's called animal communication. They use stuff like sounds, colors, body language, movements, electric signs, touches, smells, or a mix of these.
